title: Microsoft Xbox Experiences Service Outages
description: Reports of Xbox service outages have been trending, with Microsoft confirming that the issue did not affect games on disc.

sources.title: Xbox outage shouldn’t have affected games on disc, Microsoft confirms
PSA: Xbox Platforms Suffering Major Service Outage
Xbox outage turns ugly as players use Xbox App glitch to download and play titles for free

sections.heading: Xbox Service Outage
paragraphs: Xbox platforms are currently experiencing a major service outage, according to Game Informer. This has led to disruptions in the gaming experience for many users.

sections.heading: Issue with Game Discs
paragraphs: The Verge reports that Microsoft has confirmed the outage should not have affected games on disc, indicating that the problem is related to digital entitlements rather than physical media.

sections.heading: Xbox App Glitch
paragraphs: TweakTown has reported that some players have exploited a glitch in the Xbox App to download and play titles for free during the outage, turning an already negative situation into a more serious issue for Microsoft.

faq.q: What is the current status of Xbox services?
faq.a: Xbox platforms are suffering a major service outage, as reported by Game Informer.

faq.q: Did the outage affect games on disc?
faq.a: No, according to The Verge, Microsoft has confirmed that the outage did not affect games on disc.

faq.q: Is there any misuse of the Xbox App during the outage?
faq.a: Yes, TweakTown reports that some players have used a glitch in the Xbox App to download and play titles for free.
